forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif announced on 2026-06-14 that the US and Iran had finalized the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding — the product of held, mediated negotiating sessions brokered by Pakistan (named mediator). This constitutes a publicly confirmed held session before EOD 2026-06-16 per the resolution criteria. Iran's suspension of June 1 was rescinded de facto by Iranian principal (Araghchi/Pezeshkian) participation in the June 14-15 finalization process.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Iranian MFA spokesman confirms re-engagement or rescinds suspension
Omani/Qatari/Pakistani mediator readout of a convened/held session

forecasts.question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. On 2026-06-17, US President Trump and Iranian President Pezeshkian signed the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding — Trump at the Palace of Versailles during the G7, Pezeshkian in Tehran — in a simultaneously executed formal signing brokered by Pakistan with Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Egypt facilitating. TIER1-confirmed by Reuters/AP/NBC/Al Jazeera.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. In the resolution window (2026-06-10 to 2026-06-24): IDF struck Beirut-area targets on 2026-06-14, which reportedly prompted Iran to prepare a retaliation, but US intervention prevented Iranian strikes from taking place in order to allow the Islamabad MOU negotiations to proceed. No TIER1-confirmed bilateral exchange (IDF strikes on Iran AND Iran strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets in the same 48h window) occurred within this window. The June 7-8 exchange was prior to forecast creation.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: IDF + IRGC reciprocal strike statements within 48h
TIER1 confirmation of two-way strikes in a single window

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Hormuz reopened partially under the June 17 Islamabad MOU but never approached 50 transits/day in the June 17-July 2 window. AIS data (straits.live, global-energy-flow.com) records ~1 transit/day as of August 25, and the brief post-MOU partial reopening did not achieve a 7-day rolling average of ≥50 transits. Iranian vessel blacklist (46 ships), unresolved insurer P&I war-risk coverage, and incomplete demining precluded sustained commercial traffic.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

indicators.name: PortWatch 7-day transit trend rising
P&I war-risk cover reinstated for Hormuz transit

forecasts.question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-AMBIGUOUS, resolves as NO per ambiguity_rule. US deployed autonomous minehunting assets (Knifefish UUV from LCS) and Arleigh Burke destroyers for mine-clearing positioning, and UK-France multinational coalition (15 nations) was assembling. However: (1) National Defense Magazine reported July 27 that the US Navy was still 'pondering' its operational approach to mine countermeasures; (2) renewed Iranian attacks July 6-7 on three vessels led Trump to declare the truce 'over' July 7, halting safe operations; (3) a second ceasefire was needed July 31 before conditions were safe. Per ambiguity_rule: vessel positioning and planning without confirmed operational commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1/Pentagon report of MCM operations commencing
Lloyd's List clearance-lane announcement or uptick toward >10 transits/day

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. The Knesset dissolved July 17, 2026 — two days after the July 15 horizon — and set the election for the mandatory date of October 27, 2026. The resolution criteria required a fixed election date EARLIER than October 27; the coalition selected October 27 itself (the mandatory constitutional date), not an earlier date. Haredi-coalition negotiations on a September/October 20 band did not produce a final-reading vote before July 15, and the election date settled on the mandatory date rather than an accelerated one. Criterion not met on two dimensions: (a) dissolution vote after July 15 deadline, (b) election date not earlier than Oct 27.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.

indicators.name: Plenum third-reading dissolution vote held with a fixed date inserted
Haredi-coalition agreement on a fixed September/Oct-20 date

forecasts.question: Will a comprehensive US-Iran war-ending agreement be signed before EOD 2026-09-30?

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly announce or confirm resumption of uranium enrichment above 60% purity before EOD 2026-09-20?
forecasts.delta_reason: Initial: Iran suspended enrichment above 60% per the June 17 Islamabad MOU; MOU expired Aug 17 with talks deadlocked; Kayhan editorial Aug 25 called for enrichment above 60% as a 'legitimate response' to renewed sanctions (editorial opinion, not AEOI decision); IAEA continues monitoring under reduced-transparency protocols; Iran has historically used enrichment announcements as negotiating leverage within 30-60 days of diplomatic breakdown; new US Hezbollah sanctions (Aug 20) increase Iran's domestic pressure to demonstrate nuclear leverage. Base rate anchored to Iran's post-MOU escalation pattern.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Iranian government (AEOI, MFA, or Supreme Leader office) formally announces resumption of enrichment above 60% purity, confirmed by IAEA monitoring report or two independent TIER1 sources including an official Iranian government source (AEOI/IRNA), before EOD 2026-09-20.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IAEA formal statement OR two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg) including official Iranian government source (AEOI director or IRNA quoting official). Kayhan or Tasnim editorials alone do NOT resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Iranian statements about 'considering' or having the 'right' to enrich above 60% without confirmed operational restart = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; IAEA monitoring reports showing centrifuge activity above 60% without a public Iranian announcement = OBSERVED (indicator update only) — resolution requires both official announcement AND IAEA/TIER1 confirmation.

indicators.name: AEOI or Supreme Leader office formally announces enrichment restart above 60%

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE from 0.35 to 0.10. Knesset formally dissolved 2026-07-17 for the mandatory Oct 27 election — the coalition voted to dissolve together, not because of defection or majority loss. Haaretz (Aug 6) shows Netanyahu's bloc polling at ~51 seats (behind Eisenkot's Yashar-led opposition at 59-69 projected), but the coalition parties are running as a unified bloc. No party has defected. The resolution criteria requires either (a) a Knesset roll-call vote confirming coalition loss of majority (61 seats) via no-confidence or defection, OR (b) election date moving EARLIER than Oct 27 — neither condition is met and the structured dissolution makes both conditions extremely unlikely in the remaining 62 days before the scheduled election.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.
